_about: Limits for what the valley's own things cost a frame of the real style, for tools/look.mjs --check: node tools/look.mjs --shots hills,river,riverlow --styles real --check tools/look/valley.json --against tools/look/valley-baseline.json. valley-baseline.json is what the same three frames measure in a tree that has none of them (no poplars along the river, no stones at the water's edge, no gravel bars, no mist, no pier and no boat); it was measured in the tree of commit e933103, so measure it again in the tree it is to be held against (without the valley's things) before holding a frame to it. What is held is what they add at the high tier: at most 8 draws and 60 000 triangles where the river is, and no draw and no triangle where it is not.
